PROVIDING COMPLETE END TO END SOLUTIONS FOR ALL OF YOUR DATACOM/SECURITY NEEDS Federal Cable is a Manufacturer's Representative Firm specializing in Datacom, Telecom, Network Hardware, and Physical Security Solution products. Based out of Alpharetta, GA, we represent premier manufacturers and provide coverage over GA, AL, MS, TN, NC, SC, and Florida. LOW VOLTAGE/COPPER CCT (Convergent Connectivity Technology) is a manufacture of low-voltage communication wire. CCT provides its customers with a wide range of cable products for Security, Data, Control,Audio, and Video applications. With nearly 40 years of manufacturing experience, it is our goal to provide each of our customers with the quality and service they deserve and the pricing they need to stay competitive in today's market. FIBER OPTIC Stallard is a manufacturer and master distributor specializing in premium Premise and Outside Plant materials. We proudly offer an extensive range of high-quality products tailored to meet your connectivity needs. Our premier premise solutions include Fiber Optic Cables (Indoor and Indoor/Outdoor rated), Wall and Rack Mounted Fiber Enclosures, Custom Fiber Assemblies, and Cable Management systems. For outside plant applications, we provide top-tier products such as Plastic and Polymer Concrete Handholes, Conduit, Aerial Strand, and Aerial Hardware. With national coverage and a commitment to excellence, Stallard delivers reliable, innovative solutions for all your fiber optic and cabling infrastructure requirements. ​ ​ CONNECTIVITY SOLUTIONS Allen Tel Connectivity Solutions products follow our industries stringent standards to ensure your structured cabling systems meet 25-year warranty requirements. A full range of connectivity; Category 6A, 5e, fiber optics, work area outlets, patch panels, standard and specialty telephones, and more, with a systems and training program recognized by industry trade groups and other manufacturers reciprocal warranty programs. RACKS & CABINETS Hammond Manufacturing is a leading supplier of racks, cabinets, enclosures, and power strips. For more than 100 years, customers who have required unsurpassed performance, wide selection and durability for power distribution, racks and enclosures have relied on the Hammond brand. ABOUT US Federal Cable, LLC. Is a Manufacturer's Representative Firm who has served the Southeast region for over 40 years. First established in 1985, Federal Cable has thrived and become one of the Southeast's premier Rep Firms by offering factory direct pricing, extensive product knowledge, and unsurpassed customer service for all of your Low Voltage wire, Fiber Optic cable & Connectivity/Network Solution needs. As a stocking rep firm, we have the ability to provide physical product from our Alpharetta, GA warehouse for your local project needs. Product when and where you need it! ​ We have partnered with premier manufactures whose products complement each other and create synergy. By doing so, it allows us to offer full end to end solutions for all of your wire, cable, infrastructure and connectivity needs all from a single location instead of sourcing from multiple. Our goal here at Federal Cable is to maintain customer respect and loyalty by providing professional sales, service, and value in the wire and cable industry. One of many things that sets us apart from other Rep Firms is that we sell exclusively through distribution. As a family owned business, we pride ourselves on putting the customer first by going above and beyond the normal expectations. ​ Federal Cable is committed to providing the highest quality products and services to our customers. Our experienced Datacom specialists understand your needs and can fulfill your job requirements quickly and efficiently.
